daily_load_assessment: Immediate fatigue is practically non-existent with an ATL of 6.6 and a TSB of +6.3 (CTL 12.9). However, zero logged load over the last 14 days means today is a reset point. Your systemic readiness to absorb load is high, but acute neuromuscular sharpness is dormant. Today requires immediate stimulus to initiate your training block.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: The 21-day window reflects severe under-utilization, with only 2 logged sessions generating 71 TSS total. Fatigue accumulation (ATL 6.6) has dropped below baseline target, stalling adaptation rate. To reach your target CTL of 60 at a safe ramp rate of +1 to +2 per week, we must re-establish consistent acute training frequency immediately without causing acute strain.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: The 180-day macro trend demonstrates strong peak performance in mid-summer (sessions with TSS > 150-200 and solid 40-100km rides), followed by an aggressive detraining slope into November. Your baseline aerobic capacity from past commuting provides a high foundation, but your structural CTL has fallen to 12.9. Progressive overload must be restored systematically to rebuild towards CTL 60.
coach_verdict: Freshness is fully restored (TSB +6.3), clearing you for a high-intensity session. I recommend Priority 1 (Cycling VO2max / 5-min Power Intervals) as your top focus today. It directly targets your stated goal of improving 5-minute peak power capacity at 258W FTP baseline while taking advantage of your fresh state.

priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x30-sec high-cadence openers. Main Set: 5 x 3 minutes @ 285-300 W (110-116% FTP, HR > 175 bpm), with 3 minutes Zone 1 active recovery between efforts. 15 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total duration: 50 mins.
priority_1.reason: TSB is +6.3 and recent volume is low, meaning high-intensity readiness is optimal. This session directly develops your target 5-minute cycling power goal under safe total load conditions.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min Zone 2 warm-up + dynamic drills. Main Set: 5 x 1000m @ target 5km pace (RPE 8.5/10) with 90 seconds easy walking/jogging recovery between reps. 10 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total duration: ~40 mins.
priority_2.reason: Directly targets running interval quality and 5km pace adaptation. Fully viable today due to fresh leg status, provided running mechanics are prioritized.

priority_3.session_title: Lower Body Torque & Upper Body Aesthetics Strength
priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Squats: 4x5 @ 75-80% 1RM. Barbell Bench Press: 4x6. Heavy Sandbag (70kg) Clean & Carry: 3x30 meters. Barbell Overhead Press: 3x8. Core: Hanging Leg Raises 3x12. Total duration: 50 mins.
priority_3.reason: Provides foundational strength to support pedal torque and running economy, plus upper body volume, without adding high cardiovascular fatigue.
